title: PX to REM Converter
h1: PX to REM Converter — CSS Pixel and Root Font Size
seoTitle: PX to REM Converter — Pixels to Rem for CSS
description: Convert CSS pixels to rem and rem back to pixels using any root font size. Handy for design tokens and accessible type scales. Runs entirely in your browser.
intro: Enter a pixel size and the root font size used by the page. The converter shows the rem value and can turn rem back into pixels for the same root.
blurb: Convert CSS px and rem using a configurable root font size.

controls.label: Root font size (px)
controls.help: Browsers default to 16px unless html { font-size } changes it.

howItWorks: Set the root font size. 16px is the usual browser default.
Enter a pixel value and press Convert px to rem, or enter rem and press Convert rem to px.
Copy the CSS value. 1rem always equals the root font size you entered.

faq.a: A rem is a CSS length equal to the font size of the root element, usually the html element. It does not depend on the parent element's font size the way em does.

faq.q: Why would I change the root size?
faq.a: Some designs set html { font-size: 62.5% } so 1rem is 10px, or they use a larger root for accessibility. Match the root used by the stylesheet.
No. It only calculates the equivalent length so you can paste it into CSS.
